Miami-Dade

7 markets we actually serve.

Aventura, FL

Sixteen miles up Biscayne from our office. A retail and condo economy where the user is often affluent, over fifty and bilingual — which changes what "good design" means.

App development in Aventura →

Brickell, FL

Miami's financial district, and the most regulated work we do. Compliance, audit trails and security review are the project, not a footnote at the end of it.

App development in Brickell →

Coral Gables, FL

More than 100 multinational corporations and regional headquarters, many of them running Latin America from a few square miles. Formal procurement, long decision cycles, legacy systems.

App development in Coral Gables →

Doral, FL

Fifteen miles west of our office, and the densest concentration of freight forwarders, warehouses and Latin American trade offices in the country. Most Doral briefs are operations software, not consumer apps.

App development in Doral →

Hialeah, FL

Twelve miles northwest of our office and the sixth largest city in Florida. Manufacturing, food distribution, trades and family businesses — where the software has to work in Spanish and pay for itself.

App development in Hialeah →

Miami Beach, FL

Hotels, restaurants, nightlife, conventions and short-term rentals. The engineering problem here is season: the system has to hold up during Art Basel week, not on an average Tuesday.

App development in Miami Beach →

Miami, FL

Our home market. One squad on Biscayne Boulevard, working Eastern time, building for Brickell fintechs, hospitality groups and the LatAm corridor.

App development in Miami →

Broward & Palm Beach

3 markets we actually serve.

Boca Raton, FL

Corporate headquarters, insurance, wealth management and a university research park. The briefs here arrive with a procurement process attached and a twenty-year-old system to integrate with.

App development in Boca Raton →

Fort Lauderdale, FL

The yachting capital, a top-three cruise port and a real enterprise software cluster in one county. Offline-first sync and hardware integration come up here more than anywhere else we work.

App development in Fort Lauderdale →

West Palm Beach, FL

Wall Street South, a real estate boom and the Glades behind it. Most briefs here come from firms with compliance obligations, serious money and no in-house engineering team.

App development in West Palm Beach →
